title: Icon-only task manager: App being pinned in another activity affects its position in taskbar
line: An app pinned only on another activity no longer jumps to the front of the Icons-only Task Manager when you open it.
explanation: The Icons-only Task Manager sorts windows into their launcher's slot (launch-in-place). The sort and the drag barrier looked up the launcher position in the full launcher list, ignoring which activities the launcher is pinned on, so a window of an app pinned only on another activity was treated as a launcher-backed task and sorted before all other windows. The change adds a helper that returns no launcher position when the launcher isn't on the current activity, and uses it in lessThan() and move().

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: ignore launchers on other activities when sorting

With launch-in-place sorting, a window was sorted into its launcher's slot
even when the app was only pinned on another activity, so it jumped to the
front. Now only launchers on the current activity are taken into account.

BUG: 386055
